items.source: Create a new ContextExposingHttpServletRequest for the given request.
items.translation: 为给定的请求创建一个新的 ContextExposingHttpServletRequest。

items.source: context - the WebApplicationContext that this request runs in
Return the WebApplicationContext that this request runs in.
items.translation: 返回此请求运行的 WebApplicationContext。

items.source: exposedContextBeanNames - the names of beans in the context which are supposed to be exposed (if this is non-null, only the beans in this Set are eligible for exposure as attributes)
items.translation: `exposedContextBeanNames` - 上下文中应暴露的 Bean 名称（如果此值非 null，则只有此 Set 中的 Bean 有资格作为属性进行暴露）

items.source:
HttpServletRequest decorator that makes all Spring beans in a
given WebApplicationContext accessible as request attributes,
through lazy checking once an attribute gets accessed.
items.translation: 使给定 WebApplicationContext 中的所有 Spring Bean 可通过懒加载检查作为请求属性访问的 HttpServletRequest 装饰器。
